decisions.subject: Select production pipeline for VN-Myth S3E02 (Sử thi Đăm Săn)

options_considered.label: Animated Explainer Pipeline (Research -> Proposal -> Script -> Scene Plan -> Assets -> Edit -> Compose)
options_considered.reason: Fits 3-layer documented mythology + data visualization + custom Blender 3D / Remotion production cleanly.

options_considered.label: Research Video Pipeline (fact-first short report)
options_considered.reason: Good for pure journalism, weaker for epic storytelling + 3D architectural/mythic diorama staging.
options_considered.rejected_because: Too rigid for mythic narrative pacing.

decisions.reason: Standard VN-Myth series pipeline supporting research seal, bilingual-safe cultural nuance, and bespoke Remotion/Blender composition.

decisions.subject: Select final composition & motion runtime (remotion vs hyperframes vs ffmpeg)

options_considered.label: Remotion (React/TypeScript bespoke TSX compositions + Tailwind/SVG/Canvas overlays)
options_considered.reason: Supports bespoke Atelier React scenes, frame-accurate typography over Blender Cycles EXR/PNG sequences, interactive-quality SVG linguistic maps & charts, and direct reuse of VN-Myth series engine patterns.

options_considered.label: Hyperframes (HTML/CSS/GSAP headless timeline compositor)
options_considered.reason: Viable for HTML/CSS typography and DOM animation, and available locally.
options_considered.rejected_because: Less suited for complex reusable TSX infographic components and parity with existing VN-Myth S1-S3E01 React/Remotion architecture.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg Direct Filtergraph Assembly
options_considered.reason: Fast deterministic muxing and linear slideshow stitching, zero React tooling needed.
options_considered.rejected_because: Cannot render custom SVG linguistic maps, animated bar/treemap charts, or precision editorial lower-thirds.

decisions.reason: Remotion Atelier gives exact frame-level control combining Blender 3D Cycles renders with bespoke TSX infographics and caption/audio sync.

decisions.subject: Select composition mode (atelier vs templated)

options_considered.label: Atelier Mode (bespoke TSX scenes + custom Central Highlands palette & typography)
options_considered.reason: Avoids generic template cards; crafts custom spatial diagrams for Nhà dài hình thuyền, Đăm Săn 7-war stratification, and Chamic vs Mon-Khmer map.

options_considered.label: Templated Playbook Mode
options_considered.rejected_because: User approved Atelier mode for unique Central Highlands epic visual identity.

decisions.reason: Custom editorial + Blender diorama presentation requires scene-specific Atelier compositions.

decisions.subject: Select hybrid 3D + 2D visual illustration strategy using Blender 5.2.2 LTS

options_considered.label: Hybrid Blender 5.2.2 LTS Headless Cycles Diorama + Remotion 2D Editorial Infographics (documentary-montage grammar)
options_considered.reason: Blender 5.2.2 LTS is verified locally and ideal for rich clay-wood diorama/maquette 3D hero shots (Nhà dài, Đấu trường Mtao Mxây, Rừng Sáp Đen, Bộ Chiêng 6+3+1) composited seamlessly inside Remotion 2D data stories.

options_considered.label: Pure 2D AI Illustration + Remotion
options_considered.rejected_because: User explicitly requested Blender 3D illustration and approved the Hybrid Blender + Remotion recommendation.

options_considered.label: 100% Full-Frame Character Animation in Blender
options_considered.rejected_because: Unnecessary character-rigging risk and unreadable statistical charts compared to Remotion vector charts.

decisions.reason: Matte museum-diorama / maquette 3D aesthetics play to Blender's Cycles lighting strengths while keeping character stylization authentic and cultural architecture anatomically accurate.

options_considered.label: VieNeu local TTS v3 Turbo (48kHz, zero API cost) + Whisper word alignment
options_considered.reason: Native Vietnamese pronunciation (including Ê Đê loanwords phonetically guided), consistent voice identity with VN-Myth S1-S3E01, zero per-minute fee.

options_considered.label: OpenAI TTS
options_considered.rejected_because: Paid API and less natural Vietnamese epic/cultural prosody than local VieNeu.

decisions.subject: Select fresh unused CC-BY-4.0 BGM track from verified local catalog

options_considered.label: The Complex — Kevin MacLeod (104 BPM, 267.69s, Dark/Driving/Epic/Percussion, -12.7 LUFS, LRA 7.4 LU)
options_considered.reason: Unused across E04-S3E01; epic organic+percussion drive fits Đăm Săn martial & Rừng Sáp Đen climax while preserving 7.4 LU dynamic headroom for clean -20 dB voice ducking.

options_considered.label: Fearless First — Kevin MacLeod (92 BPM, 195.65s, Guitar/Bass/Drums/Flute, -7.0 LUFS, LRA 1.6 LU)
options_considered.rejected_because: Loudness check measured -7.0 LUFS with compressed LRA 1.6 LU and heavy bass requiring aggressive EQ.

options_considered.label: Wallpaper — Kevin MacLeod (92 BPM, 220s, Bright/Bouncy Synths)
options_considered.rejected_because: Upbeat corporate tech feel clashes with Central Highlands heroic tragedy.

decisions.reason: Best emotional fit (epic percussion & tension), clean verified sha256 c270fb44a69828f6cae7412e077a38b92d55015d30ced549d0d477f864e7e41e, and widest dynamic headroom (-12.7 LUFS, LRA 7.4 LU).

options_considered.reason: Combines mythic cliffhanger hook, 2-vs-7 wars textual revelation, Austronesian Chamic vs Austroasiatic continuity from S3E01, and rich 3D Blender diorama staging.
